message.content:
This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine features a centered figure in a white, long-sleeved shirt and black pants, appearing to run forward. This figure holds a yellow cylindrical baton aloft in their right hand. To the left, a figure with dark hair in a ponytail wears a long red garment, reaching toward the central figure. On the right, a white-haired figure in a red shirt and black pants also moves forward. Another hand in a red sleeve grasps the white-haired figure’s right ankle.

The background is blue with yellow diagonal stripes, suggesting a track. Large red letters spell "TEMPO" across the top. Indonesian text at the top reads "KORUPSI HIBAH PESANTREN BANTEN" and "KUNCI KEMENANGAN TIM PIALA THOMAS." The center text reads "BARA DI PARTAI MERAH" in large white block letters, followed by a paragraph in smaller white font and "25-31 OKTOBER 2021." A barcode and QR code are in the bottom left corner. The figures cast long dark shadows forward on the blue surface. The illustration uses a grainy, textured graphic style.
